description: Fastmail email connector over native JMAP (Tier-4 EMAIL class). Indexes the user's Fastmail mailbox as `fastmail:email` items — message HEADERS (subject, from, to/cc, received date, message-id), a short capped plain-text body PREVIEW (~2 KB / 2000 chars), and attachment METADATA only (filename, size, mimetype). It NEVER downloads or parses attachment bytes and never fetches the full message body: the JMAP `Email/get` calls request `maxBodyValueBytes` so the server truncates the body value before it crosses the wire, and only the `attachments` body-part metadata is read — the `blobId` download URL is never dereferenced. Read tools (`fastmail_list`, `fastmail_get`, `fastmail_search`) plus one HITL-gated write tool (`fastmail_mail_send`) that submits a new email via JMAP EmailSubmission. Auth is a single Fastmail API token, injected as the scoped environment variable FASTMAIL_API_TOKEN at spawn time (with an optional FASTMAIL_BASE_URL override) — the connector never reads the vault. JMAP is pure HTTPS to api.fastmail.com (the session, api, and any upload/download endpoints are all under that host), so the sandbox network allow-list is a single static 443 host.
author: Nimbus
